hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-7xl lg:text-[10vw] font-light tracking-tighter leading-none

gradients.paper_texture: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 200 200' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='noiseFilter'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.85' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23noiseFilter)' opacity='0.05'/%3E%3C/svg%3E")

visual_enhancers.noise: All dark sections must have a subtle noise overlay (opacity-20 pointer-events-none fixed inset-0 z-50 mix-blend-overlay) to simulate a cinematic, grainy night sky.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use py-32 to py-64 for section padding. The design should feel empty, quiet, and vast, like the night sky.
layouts.alignment: Optical alignment. Center the hero text and finale, but use staggered, asymmetric left/right alignments for the manifesto chapters to create rhythm.
layouts.containers: Use max-w-7xl mx-auto px-6 or px-12. Avoid harsh borders or boxes; let content float in the dark.

rules: Hero Reveal: Line-by-line staggered reveal using Framer Motion (initial y: 100%, clipPath: 'polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%)').
Parallax Lanterns: Use Framer Motion useScroll and useTransform to make lanterns float upward at different speeds as the user scrolls.
Marquee: Use framer-motion or react-fast-marquee for a very slow, continuous editorial marquee.
Scroll Reveal: Every manifesto chapter fades in and drifts up slightly (y: 50 -> 0, opacity 0 -> 1, duration: 1.2, ease: 'easeOut') when scrolling into view.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure pale gold and white text over the dark sky background meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the parallax and canvas stars.
accessibility.testing: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements, like the final forgiveness button.

3d_libraries: No heavy 3D library required. Use a lightweight HTML5 Canvas script or tsparticles for the starry background.
Use Framer Motion for the floating image/SVG lanterns.

image_urls.description: Floating paper lanterns in the night sky. Can be used as a parallax background layer.
Starry night sky texture for blending over the void background.

media.icons: lucide-react (Use very sparingly. Maybe a subtle ArrowDown for the scroll indicator, or a Star icon).

sections.name: Hero
sections.details: Dark void background with starry canvas and layered parallax lanterns. Center text: Massive 'I'm Sorry' masked line reveal. Below it, in Parisienne script: 'To someone special'. Absolute bottom center: glowing scroll indicator.

sections.name: Editorial Marquee
sections.details: Slow-moving pale gold text. 'FORGIVE ME • A THOUSAND APOLOGIES • A THOUSAND STARS • ' repeated.

sections.name: Manifesto Chapters
sections.details: Numbered sections (01, 02, 03). Alternate left and right alignment. Huge gold numbers. Short, heartfelt paragraphs. Elements fade in on scroll. Background remains deep indigo.

sections.name: The Letter
sections.details: Background hard-transitions (or cross-fades via framer-motion) to 'soft_paper' (#F4EFEA) with noise texture. Ink black text (#1A1A1A). The text is written entirely in the 'Parisienne' font, feeling like a heartfelt, raw apology letter.

sections.name: Forgiveness Finale
sections.details: Transition back to the dark starry sky. A single, glowing button or interactive lantern in the center. 'Will you forgive me?' Upon clicking, a beautiful, gentle animation occurs (e.g., text changes to 'Thank You', lanterns flood the screen, or a soft golden glow overtakes the page).

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure you install framer-motion, lucide-react, and @studio-freight/react-lenis (or lenis). Include the Google Fonts for Cormorant Garamond (weights 300, 400, 500) and Parisienne in the index.html. DO NOT use generic fonts. Build a highly emotional, beautifully animated experience. Prioritize the staggering and smoothness of Framer Motion animations. The background transition from Dark Sky to Soft Paper must feel deliberate and clean.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not apply 'transition: all' globally. Use specific transitions. Ensure micro-interactions on the final button. Keep z-index hierarchy strict (stars in back, lanterns mid, text front). No emojis. Use data-testid for the final button.
